title: Transverse Back Stroking
summary: Broad gentle passes move across the back muscles from the central area toward the sides.
goal: Introduce a different direction of gentle contact and prepare the lateral back for further work.
imageAlt: Educational diagram of transverse back stroking without text labels.
startingPosition: The person lies face down. Position the palms on one side of the spine or symmetrically on both sides.
instructions: Place the palm on soft tissue next to the spine.
Glide across the muscles toward the side of the torso.
Reduce pressure as you approach the outer edge.
Return without pressure and repeat slightly above or below.
When using both hands, keep an even rhythm.
direction: From the central back toward the side of the torso, across the muscle region.
tips: Use the broad surface of the palm.
Keep the glide smooth without pinching the skin.
warning: Do not perform this technique over acute pain, recent injury, significant inflammation, damaged skin, or when touch increases symptoms. Seek qualified professional advice when uncertain.
